zh: 第二天仍如前一天那样嘴上很客气，眼中不容情，将唐子韶的弊端，一样一样，追究到底。唐子韶的态度，却跟前一天有异，仿佛对马逢时及杨书办的作为，不甚在意。只是坐在一边，不断地抽水烟，有时将一根纸煤搓了又搓，直到搓断，方始有爽然若失的神情，显得他在肚子里的功夫，做得根深。约莫刚交午时，公济开出点心来，请马逢时暂时休息。唐子韶便趁此时机，将杨书办邀到一边有话说。“杨先生，”他问：“今天查得完查不完？”一想把它查完。““以后呢？”唐子韶问道：“不是说好商量？”“不错，好商量。你最好去寻周少棠，只要他那里谈好了，马大老爷这里归我负责。”唐子韶迟疑了好一会说：“本来是谈好了，哪晓得马大老爷一来，要从头查起。语气中仿佛在埋怨杨书办跟周少棠彼此串通，有意推来推去，不愿帮忙。杨书办心想，也难怪他误会，其中的关键，不妨点他一句。“老兄，你不要一厢情愿！你这里查都还没有查过，无从谈起，更不必说啥谈好了。你今天晚上去寻他，包你有结果。“唐子韶恍然大悟，原来是要看他在公济典里弄了多少“好处”，然后再来谈“价钱”。看样子打算用几千银子“摆平”，是一种不切实际的妄想。“树倒猢狲散”，不如带着月如远走高飞，大不了从此不吃朝奉这一行的饭，后半世应可衣食无忧。就在这刹那间打定了主意，就更不在乎杨书办与马逢时了，不过表面上仍旧很尊敬，当天查帐完毕，要请他们吃饭。马逢时当然坚辞，杨书办且又暗示，应该早早去觅周少棠“商量”。
en: The next day the inspection continued as before: polite words, unsparing eyes. Tang Zishao’s irregularities were pursued one by one to the end. His own manner, however, had changed. He seemed scarcely concerned with what Ma Fengshi and Clerk Yang were doing, merely sitting to one side and smoking his water pipe. Sometimes he rolled a paper spill between his fingers again and again until it broke; only then did he look momentarily lost, revealing how deeply his mind was at work. Shortly after noon began, Gongji served refreshments and invited Ma to rest. Tang took the opportunity to draw Yang aside. “Mr Yang, can you finish the inspection today?” “We mean to try.” “And afterward? Didn’t you say we could discuss things?” “Certainly. You had better find Zhou Shaotang. Once you have settled matters with him, I’ll answer for His Honour Ma.” Tang hesitated for some time. “I thought we had settled things already. Who could have known His Honour would come and insist on examining everything from the beginning?” His tone suggested that Yang and Zhou were working together, deliberately passing him back and forth without helping. Yang thought the misunderstanding natural enough; he might as well give him a hint. “My dear fellow, don’t indulge in wishful thinking. Before we’ve even examined the place, there’s nothing to discuss, let alone settle. Go and see him tonight. I guarantee you’ll get a result.” Tang suddenly understood. They wanted to see how much he had taken from Gongji before naming their price. Expecting to settle everything for a few thousand taels was an absurd dream. When the tree fell, the monkeys scattered. Better to take Yueru and flee far away. At worst, he would never work as a pawnbroker again; he should still have enough to live comfortably for the rest of his life. The decision formed in an instant, leaving him even less concerned with Yang and Ma, though outwardly he remained respectful. When the day’s examination ended, he invited them to dinner. Ma firmly declined, while Yang again hinted that he should find Zhou early and “discuss matters.”

zh: 唐子韶口头上边声称“是”，其实根本无此打算，他要紧的是赶回家去跟月如商量。约略说了经过，随即向月如透露了他的决心。“三十六计，走为上让。你从现在起始，就要预备，最好三、五天之内料理清楚，我们开溜，”月如一愣，“溜到哪里？”她说：“徽州我是不去。”唐子韶的结发妻子在徽州原籍，要月如去服低做小，亲操井臼，宁死不愿，这一层意思表明过不止一次，唐子韶当然明白。“我怎么会让你到徽州去吃苦？就算你自己要去，我也舍不得。我想有三个地方，一个是上海，一个是北京，再有一个是扬州，我在那里有两家亲戚。”只要不让她到徽州，他处都不妨从长计议，但最好是能不走，上生上长三十年，从没有出过远门，怕到了他乡水土不服住不惯。
en: Tang repeatedly agreed, without the least intention of doing so. His urgent business was to get home and consult Yueru. After briefly describing what had happened, he revealed his decision. “Of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, running away is the best. Start preparing now. We should have everything ready in three to five days, then slip away.” Yueru stared. “Where to? I won’t go to Huizhou.” Tang’s first wife remained in his native Huizhou. Yueru would rather die than go there to take a subordinate place and do the household drudgery herself. She had made that clear more than once, and he knew it perfectly. “How could I send you to suffer in Huizhou? Even if you wanted to go, I couldn’t bear it. I have three places in mind: Shanghai, Beijing, or Yangzhou, where I have two sets of relatives.” Provided Huizhou was excluded, the choice could be discussed at leisure. Better still, though, would be not to leave at all. Yueru had lived here all her thirty years and had never traveled far. She feared that elsewhere the climate and water would disagree with her and she would not settle.

zh: “不走办不到，除非倾家荡产。”“有这么厉害？”“自然。”唐子韶答说：“这姓周的，良心黑，手段辣，如今一盘帐都抄了去，一笔一笔照算，没有五万银子不能过门。”“你不会赖掉？”“把柄在人家千里，怎么赖得掉？”“不理他呢？”“不理他？你去试试看。”唐子韶说：“姓马的是候补县，奉了宪谕来查封，权力大得很呢！只要他说一句，马上可以送我到仁和县班房，你来送牢饭吧！”月如叹口气说：“那就只好到上海去了。只怕到了上海还是保不得平安。”“一定可以保！”唐子韶信心十足地说，“上海市场等于外国地方，哪怕是道台也不能派差役去抓人，上海县更加不必谈了。而且上海市场上五方杂处，各式各样的人都有，只要有钱，每天大摇大摆，坐马车、逛张园、吃大菜、看京戏，没有哪个来管你的闲事。”听他形容上海的繁华，月如大为动心，满腔离愁，都丢在九霄云外，细细盘算了一会说道：“好在现款存在汇丰银行，细软随身带了走，有三天工夫总可以收拾好，不动产只好摆在那里再说。不过，这三天当中，会不会出事呢？”
en: “We can’t stay, unless we’re prepared to lose everything.” “Is it as bad as that?” “Of course. This Zhou has a black heart and a ruthless hand. They have copied all the accounts. Once he adds them up item by item, it will take fifty thousand taels to get past him.” “Can’t you deny it?” “With the evidence in their hands?” “What if you ignore him?” “Try it! Ma is an expectant magistrate acting under his superior’s orders. He has enormous powers. One word from him, and I’m in the lockup at Renhe. You can bring me my meals there.” Yueru sighed. “Then it will have to be Shanghai. But even there, we may not be safe.” “We certainly will!” Tang declared confidently. “The foreign settlement is practically foreign territory. Even the circuit intendant can’t send runners in to arrest people, let alone the Shanghai magistrate. People come there from everywhere, every sort imaginable. So long as you have money, you can swagger about every day, ride in carriages, visit Zhang Garden, eat Western meals, and watch Beijing opera. Nobody will meddle in your affairs.” This picture of Shanghai’s pleasures thoroughly tempted Yueru. All her sorrow at leaving vanished. After careful thought, she said, “Fortunately, the cash is in HSBC. We can take our valuables with us and should be packed within three days. The property we can’t move will have to stay for now. But might something happen during those three days?”

zh: “当然要用缓兵之计。杨书办要我今天晚上就去看周少棠。他一定会开个价钱出来，漫天讨价，就地还钱，一定谈不拢，我请他明天晚上来吃饭，你好好下点功夫……”“又要来这一套了！”月如吼了起来，“你当我什么人看。”“我当你大慈大悲、救苦救难的观世音菩萨看。”唐子韶说：“这姓周的请我吃空心汤圆，你要替我报仇。““报仇？哼，”月如冷笑，“我不来管你的事！你弄得不好‘赔了夫人又折兵’，我白白里又让人家占一回便宜，啥犯着？”“你真傻，你不会请他吃个空心汤圆？两三天一拖拖过去，我们人都到上海了，他到哪里去占你的便宜？”“万一，”月如问说：“万一他来个霸王硬上弓呢？”“你不会叫？一叫，我会来救你。”“那不是变成仙人跳了？而且，你做初一，他做初二。看起来我一定要去送牢饭了。”唐子韶不作声。月如不是他的结发妻子，而且当初已经失过一回身，反正不是从一而终了，再让周少棠尝一回甜头，亦无所谓。不过这话不便说得太露骨，只好点她一句。“如果你不愿意送牢饭，实在说，你是不忍心我去吃牢饭，那么全在你发个善心了。”月如亦不作声，不过把烧饭的老妈子唤了来，关照她明天要杀鸡，要多买菜。
en: “We must play for time. Yang told me to see Zhou tonight. He’s bound to name a price. He’ll ask the earth, and I’ll bargain him down. Naturally, we won’t agree. I’ll invite him to dinner tomorrow evening, and you must make a special effort…” “That trick again!” Yueru shouted. “What do you take me for?” “The compassionate Guanyin herself, saving those in distress. This Zhou fed me an empty dumpling. You must avenge me.” “Avenge you?” She gave a cold laugh. “I’ll have nothing to do with it. You may end up losing the lady as well as the troops, and I’ll have let another man take advantage of me for nothing. Why should I?” “Don’t be foolish. Can’t you give him an empty dumpling too? Drag it out for two or three days, and we’ll be in Shanghai. How will he take advantage of you then?” “Suppose he forces himself on me?” “Can’t you shout? I’ll come and rescue you.” “Then it becomes a blackmail set-up. And what you do to him one day, he’ll repay the next. It looks as though I’ll be bringing you prison meals after all.” Tang fell silent. Yueru was not his first wife, and she had already once slept with another man. Since lifelong fidelity was no longer in question, he thought, it would hardly matter if Zhou enjoyed her favors too. But he could not say so crudely and could only hint. “If you don’t want to bring meals to prison—if, in truth, you can’t bear to see me imprisoned—then everything depends on your showing a little compassion.” Yueru said nothing either. She merely called the serving woman who did the cooking and told her to kill a chicken and buy extra food for the following day.

zh: 周少棠兴冲冲地到了元宝街，要看胡雪岩，不道一说来意，就碰了一个钉子。“说实话，周先生，”胡家的门上说：“生病是假，挡驾是真。你老倒想想，我们老爷还有啥心思见客。我通报，一定去通报，不过，真的不见，你老也不要见怪。”“我是有正事同他谈。”“正事？”门上大摇其头，“那就一定见不着，我们老爷一提起钱庄、当店、丝行，头就大了。”“那么，你说我来看看他。”“也只好这样说。不过，”门上一面起步，一面咕哝着，“我看是白说。”见此光景，周少棠的心冷了。默默盘算，自己想帮忙的意思到了，胡雪岩不见，是没法子的事。唐子韶当然不能便宜他，不妨想想看，用什么手段卡住他的喉咙，让他把吞下去的东西吐出来：过年了，施棉衣、施米、做做好事，也是阴功积德。这一落入沉恩，就不觉得时光慢了，忽然听得一声：“周先生！”抬头看时，是门上在他面前，“我们老爷有请，”“喔，”周少棠定定神说：“居然见我了？”“原来周先生是我们老爷四十年的老朋友。”门上赔笑说道：“我不晓得！周先生你不要见气。”“哪里，哪里！你请领路。”
en: Zhou went eagerly to Yuanbao Street to see Hu Xueyan, only to meet a rebuff as soon as he explained his purpose. “To be frank, Mr Zhou,” the doorkeeper said, “illness is an excuse; the master is refusing visitors. Just think—what mood can he be in to receive anyone? I’ll announce you, certainly, but if he won’t see you, please don’t take offense.” “I have serious business to discuss with him.” “Business?” The man shook his head vigorously. “Then you definitely won’t see him. Mention the bank, pawnshops, or silk business, and his head begins to ache.” “Then say I’ve come to visit him.” “That’s all I can say. Still…” As he started off, the doorkeeper muttered, “I doubt it will do any good.” Zhou’s enthusiasm cooled. He reflected silently that he had done his part in wishing to help; if Hu would not see him, nothing could be done. Tang must not be let off, of course. He could think of some means of gripping the man by the throat and making him disgorge what he had swallowed. The New Year was coming. Distributing padded clothes and rice would do good and earn merit in the unseen world. Absorbed in these thoughts, he lost track of time, until a sudden “Mr Zhou!” made him look up. The doorkeeper stood before him. “The master asks you in.” “Oh!” Zhou collected himself. “So he will see me after all?” “I didn’t know you were his friend of forty years!” the man said with an apologetic smile. “Please don’t be offended.” “Not at all. Lead the way.”

zh: 门上领到花园人口处，有个大丫头由一个老妈子陪着，转引客人直上百狮楼。“周先生走好！”一上楼便有个中年丽人在迎接，周少棠见过一次，急忙拱手说：“螺蛳太太，不敢当，不敢当！”“大先生在里头等你。”说着螺蛳太太亲自揭开门帘，周少棠是头一回到这里，探头一望，目迷五色，东也是灯，西也是灯，东也是胡雪岩，西也是胡雪岩。灯可以有多少盏，胡雪岩不可能分身，周少棠警告自己，这里在镜子很多，不要象刘姥姥进了怕红院那样闹笑话。因此，进门先站住脚，看清楚了再说。“少棠！”胡雪岩在喊：“这面坐。”循声觅人，只见胡雪岩坐在一张红丝绒的安乐椅上，上身穿的小对襟棉袄，下身围着一条花格子的毛毡，额头上扎一条寸许宽的缎带，大概是头痛的缘故。“坐这里！”胡雪岩拍一拍他身旁的绣墩，指着头上笑道：“你看我这副样子，象不象产妇做月子？”这时候还有心思说笑话，周少棠心怀一宽，看样子他的境况，不如想象中那么坏。
en: At the garden entrance the doorkeeper handed him over to a senior maid accompanied by an older serving woman, who led him straight to the Hundred Lions Tower. “Mind your step, Mr Zhou!” A beautiful middle-aged woman greeted him upstairs. He had met her once before and hastily clasped his hands. “Madam Luosi! You are too kind!” “Mr Hu is waiting inside.” She lifted the curtain herself. This was Zhou’s first visit to these rooms. Looking in, he was dazzled: lamps to the east, lamps to the west; Hu Xueyan to the east, Hu Xueyan to the west. There might be any number of lamps, but Hu could not multiply himself. He warned himself that there were many mirrors here: he must not make a fool of himself like Granny Liu entering Yihong Court. He stopped just inside the doorway to get his bearings. “Shaotang! Sit over here.” Following the voice, he found Hu in a red-velvet armchair, wearing a short padded jacket buttoned down the front, with a checked woolen blanket around his lower body. A satin band about a cun wide was tied around his forehead, presumably for a headache. “Sit here.” Hu patted the embroidered stool beside him and pointed to his head with a smile. “Don’t I look like a woman resting after childbirth?” If he could still joke, Zhou thought with relief, perhaps things were not as bad as he had imagined.

zh: 于是闲闲谈起查封公济典的事，原原本本、巨细靡遗，最后谈到从唐子韶那里追出中饱的款子以后，如何分派的办法。“算了，算了。”胡雪岩说：“不必认真。”此言一出，周少棠愣住了，好半天才说了句：“看起来，倒是我多事了，”“少棠，你这样子一说，我变成半吊子了。事到如今，我同你说老实话，我不是心甘情愿做洋盘瘟生，不分好歹，不识是非，我是为了另外一个人。”“为了哪一个？”周少棠当然要追问。“唐子韶的姨太太。”“喔，喔！”周少棠恍然大悟，他亦久知胡雪岩有此一段艳闻，此刻正好求证：“我听说，唐子韶设美人局，你上了他的当？”“也不算上当，是我一时糊涂。这话也不必去说它了。”胡雪岩紧接着说：“昨天我同我的几个妾说：我放你们一条生路，愿意走的自己房间里东西都带走，我另外送五千银子。想想月如总同我好过。现在有了这样一个机会，我想放他一马。不过，这是马逢时的公事，又是你出了大力，我只好说一声：多谢你！到底应该怎么办？我也不敢多干预。”“原来你是这么一种心思，倒是我错怪你了。”同少棠又说：“原来是我想替你尽点心，你不忘记者相好，想这样子办，我当然照你的意思。至于论多论少，我要看情形办，而且我要告诉人家。”
en: He began casually describing the inspection of Gongji, recounting the whole affair without omitting the smallest detail. Finally he explained how the money was to be divided once recovered from Tang. “Let it go,” Hu said. “There’s no need to pursue it so seriously.” Zhou stared. Only after a long silence could he say, “It seems I’ve been meddling unnecessarily.” “Shaotang, that makes me sound a halfwit. Let me tell you the truth. I’m not willingly playing the gullible fool, unable to distinguish good from bad or right from wrong. I’m thinking of someone else.” “Who?” Zhou naturally asked. “Tang’s concubine.” “Ah!” Zhou understood at once. He had long known of Hu’s amorous adventure and now had a chance to confirm it. “I heard Tang laid a beauty trap and you fell into it?” “It wasn’t exactly that. I lost my head for a moment. There’s no need to discuss it now.” Hu went on, “Yesterday I told my concubines: ‘I’m giving you a way out. Any of you who wish to leave may take everything in your rooms, and I’ll give you five thousand taels besides.’ Yueru, after all, once shared my affection. Now that I have this opportunity, I’d like to let Tang off. But it is Ma Fengshi’s official business, and you have gone to such trouble. All I can do is thank you. I wouldn’t presume to interfere too much with how it is handled.” “So that is what you have in mind. I misjudged you. I only wanted to do something for you. If you remember an old lover and want it handled this way, naturally I’ll follow your wishes. As for how much or how little, I must judge by circumstances. And I shall tell them.”

zh: “不必，不必！不必说破。”胡雪岩忽然神秘地一笑，“少棠，你记不记得石塔儿头的‘豆腐西施’阿香？”周少棠愣了一下，从尘封的记忆中，找出阿香的影子来——石塔儿头是地名，有家豆腐店的女儿，就是阿香，艳声四播。先是周少棠做了入幕之宾，后来胡雪岩做了他的所谓“同靴弟兄”，周少棠就绝迹不去了。少年春梦，如今回想起来，什么感觉都没有了，只是奇怪胡雪岩何以忽然提了起来？“当初那件事，我心里一直难过，‘兔子不吃窝边草’，我不该割你的靴腰子。现在顶好一报还一报。”胡雪岩放低了声音说：“月如是匹扬州人所说的‘瘦马，，你倒骑她一骑看。”听此一说，周少棠有点动心，不过口头上却是一叠连声地道：“笑话，笑话！”胡雪岩不作声，笑容慢慢地收敛，双眼却不断眨动，显然有个念头在转。“那么，少棠，我说一句决不是笑话的话，你要不要听？”“要的。”
en: “No, no! Don’t explain it.” Hu suddenly smiled mysteriously. “Shaotang, do you remember A’xiang, the ‘Tofu Beauty’ at Shita’ertou?” Zhou paused, retrieving her image from the dust of memory. Shita’ertou was a place name. A’xiang, the daughter of a tofu-shop owner there, had been famous for her beauty. Zhou had first become her lover; later Hu had become his so-called “brother sharing the same boots,” and Zhou had stopped visiting altogether. Looking back on that youthful dream of love, he felt nothing now. He only wondered why Hu had suddenly brought it up. “I’ve always felt bad about that. A rabbit shouldn’t eat the grass beside its own burrow. I shouldn’t have poached on you. Now it would be best to repay you in kind.” Lowering his voice, Hu said, “Yueru is what Yangzhou people call a ‘slender horse.’ Why don’t you try riding her?” Zhou felt a flicker of interest, though he repeatedly protested, “You must be joking!” Hu said nothing. His smile slowly faded, while his eyes kept blinking: plainly another thought was forming. “Then, Shaotang, would you like to hear something that is certainly no joke?” “Yes.”

zh: “年大将军的故事，你总晓得罗？”“年大将军”是指年羹尧。这位被杭州人神乎其词他说他“一夜工夫连降十八级“的年大将军，在杭州大概有半年的辰光，他是先由一等公降为杭州将军，然后又降为”闲散章京“，满洲话叫做”拜他喇布勒哈番“，汉名叫做”骑都尉“，正四品，被派为西湖边上涌金门的城守尉，杭州关于他的故事极多，所以周少棠问说：”你是问哪一个？““是年大将军赠妾的故事。”这是众多年羹尧的故事中，最富传奇性的一个。据说，年羹尧每天坐在涌金门口，进出乡人，震于他的威名，或者避道而行，或者俯首疾趋，惟有一个穷书生，早晚进出，必定恭恭敬敬地作一个揖。这样过了几个月，逮捕年羹尧入京的上谕到了杭州，于是第二夭一早，年羹尧等那穷书生经过时，喊住他说：“我看你人很忠厚，我这番入京，大概性命不保，有个小妾想送给你，请你照料，千万不要推辞。”那个穷书生哪敢作此非分之想，一再推辞，年羹尧则一再相劝。最后，穷书生说了老实话，家徒四壁，添一口人实在养不起。“原来是为这一层，你无庸担心，明天我派人送她去。你住哪里？”问了半天，穷书生才说了他家的住址。下一天黄昏，一乘小轿到门，随携少数“嫁妆”。那轿中走出来一个风信年华的丽人，便是年羹尧的爱妾。穷书生无端得此一段艳福，自然喜心翻倒，但却不知往后何以度日。那丽人一言不发，只将带来的一张双抽屉的桌子，开锁打开抽屉，里面装满了珠宝，足供一生。
en: “You know the stories about General Nian, surely?” General Nian was Nian Gengyao. Hangzhou people told fantastic tales of his being “demoted eighteen ranks in a single night.” He had spent roughly six months in the city, first reduced from duke of the first class to Hangzhou Garrison General, then to an unattached officer—baitalabulehafan in Manchu, cavalry commandant in Chinese, of the regular fourth rank—and assigned as commander of the guard at Yongjin Gate beside West Lake. There were so many stories about him in Hangzhou that Zhou asked, “Which one?” “The story of General Nian giving away his concubine.” This was one of the most remarkable of the many Nian Gengyao legends. It was said that he sat every day at Yongjin Gate. Country people passing through, awed by his formidable reputation, either avoided him or hurried past with lowered heads. Only a poor scholar, who came and went morning and evening, always greeted him with a respectful bow. Several months passed. Then an imperial order arrived for Nian’s arrest and removal to the capital. Early the next morning, he stopped the scholar. “I can see that you’re an honest, kindhearted man. I doubt I shall survive this journey to the capital. I have a concubine I should like to give you. Please look after her, and do not refuse.” The poor scholar dared not entertain such an extravagant thought. He repeatedly declined, while Nian repeatedly urged him. Finally he admitted the truth: his house was bare, and he could not afford another mouth to feed. “So that is the difficulty! You needn’t worry. I’ll send her tomorrow. Where do you live?” Only after much questioning did the scholar reveal his address. At dusk the next day, a small sedan arrived, accompanied by a modest “dowry.” A beautiful woman in the bloom of her twenties stepped out: Nian’s favorite concubine. The scholar was overwhelmed with joy at this unexpected romantic good fortune, yet did not know how they would live. Without a word, the woman unlocked the two drawers of a table she had brought. They were full of jewels—enough for a lifetime.

zh: “我现在跟年大将军差不多。”胡雪岩说：“我的几个妾，昨天走了一半，有几个说一定要跟我，有一个想走不走，主意还没有定，看她的意思是怕终身无靠。我这个妾人很老实，我要替她好好找个靠得住的人。少棠，你把她领了回去。”“你说笑话了！”周少棠毫不思索地说，“没有这个道理！”“怎么会没有这个道理。你没有听‘说大书’的讲过，这种赠妾、赠马的事，古人常常有的。现在是我送给你，可不是你来夺爱，怕啥？”周少棠不作声，他倒是想推辞，但找不出理由，最后只好这样说：“我要同我老婆去商量看。”
en: “I am much like General Nian now,” Hu said. “Half my concubines left yesterday. Some insist on staying with me. One has not decided whether to go; I think she fears having nobody to depend on for the rest of her life. She is a very honest woman, and I want to find someone trustworthy for her. Shaotang, take her home with you.” “You’re joking!” Zhou replied without thinking. “There can be no question of it.” “Why not? Haven’t you heard the storytellers? People in the old days often gave away concubines or horses. I’m offering her to you; you aren’t stealing my beloved. What is there to fear?” Zhou fell silent. He wanted to refuse but could find no reason. At last he could only say, “I must discuss it with my wife.”

zh: 第二天一大早，周少棠还在床上，杨书办便来敲门了。起床迎接，周少棠先为前一日晚上失迎致歉，接着动问来意。“唐子韶！”杨书办说：“昨天早晚就来看我，要我陪了他来看你。看起来此人倒蛮听话，我昨天叫他晚上来看你，他真的来了。”“此刻呢？人在哪里？”“我说我约好了你，再招呼他来见面，叫他先回去。你看，在哪里碰头？”“要稍为隐蔽一点的地方。”“那么，在我家里好了。”杨书办说：“我去约他，你洗了脸、吃了点心就来。”周少棠点点头，送杨书办出门以后，一面漱洗，一面盘算，想到胡雪岩昨天的话，不免怦然心动，想看看月如倒是怎么样的一匹“瘦马”？到得杨家，唐子韶早就到了，一见周少棠，忙不迭地站了起来，反客为主，代替杨书办招待后到之客，十分殷勤。“少棠兄，”杨书办站起来说：“ 你们谈谈，我料理了一桩小事，马上过来。中午在我这里便饭。”这是让他们得以密谈，声明备饭，更是暗示不妨详谈、长谈。
en: Early the next morning, while Zhou was still in bed, Clerk Yang knocked at his door. Zhou rose to receive him, apologized for having been out the previous evening, and asked why he had come. “Tang Zishao! He came to see me last night and asked me to accompany him to your place. He seems quite obedient. I told him yesterday to see you in the evening, and he really came.” “Where is he now?” “I said I’d arrange a meeting with you and let him know, then sent him home. Where shall you meet?” “Somewhere reasonably secluded.” “My house, then. I’ll fetch him. Come over when you’ve washed and had something to eat.” Zhou nodded. After seeing Yang out, he washed and considered his plans. Remembering Hu’s words the previous day, he could not help feeling tempted. He wanted to see what sort of “slender horse” Yueru might be. Tang was already at Yang’s house when Zhou arrived. He hastily stood and, behaving like the host rather than a guest, attended to the newcomer with great solicitude. “Brother Shaotang,” Yang said as he rose, “you two talk. I have a small matter to attend to and will be back shortly. Stay for a simple lunch.” He was leaving them to speak privately; mentioning lunch further suggested that they need not hurry and could discuss everything at length.

zh: 但实际上无须花多少辰光，因为唐子韶成竹在胸，不必抵赖，当周少棠出示由杨书办抄来的清单，算出他一共侵吞了八万三千多银子时，他双膝一跪，口中说道：“周先生，请你救救我。”“言重，言重！”周少棠赶紧将他拉了起来，“唐朝奉，你说要我救你，不管我办得到、办不到，你总要拿出一个办法来，我才好斟酌。”“周先生，我先说实话，陆陆续续挪用了胡大先生的架本，也是叫没奈何！这几年运气不好，做生意亏本，我那个小妾又好赌，输掉不少。胡大先生现在落难，我如果有办法，早就应该把这笔款子补上了。”“照此说来，你是‘铁公鸡，一毛不拔，？”“不是，不是。”唐子韶说，一我手里还有点古董、玉器。我知道周先生你是大行家，什么时候到我那里看看，能值多少？“唐子韶略停一下又说：”现款是没有多少，我再尽量凑。““你能凑多少？”“一时还算不出。总要先看了那些东西，估个价，看缺多少，再想办法。”原来这是唐子韶投其所好，编出来的一套话。周少棠玩玉器，在“茶会”上颇有名声，听了唐子韶的话信以为真，欣然答说：“好！你看什么时候，我去看看。”“就是今天晚上好不好，”唐子韶说：“小妾做的菜，很不坏。我叫她显显手段，请周先生来赏鉴赏鉴。”一听这话，周少棠色心与食指皆动，不过不能不顾到杨书办与马逢时，因而说道：“你不该请我一个。”“我知道，我知道。马大老爷我不便请他，我再请杨书办。”
en: In fact, little time was needed, for Tang had his plan ready and had no intention of denying anything. When Zhou produced Yang’s copied list and calculated that the total embezzled exceeded eighty-three thousand taels, Tang dropped to his knees. “Mr Zhou, please save me!” “Please, please!” Zhou hastily pulled him up. “Mr Tang, whether or not I can save you, you must first propose some course for me to consider.” “Let me tell the truth. I took money from Mr Hu’s capital little by little because I had no choice. My luck has been bad these past few years. I lost money in business, and my concubine loves gambling and has lost a great deal too. Now that Mr Hu is in trouble, if I had any means of doing so, I ought to have replaced the money long ago.” “So you’re an iron rooster, unwilling to part with a single feather?” “No, no! I still have a few antiques and jades. I know you are an expert. Perhaps you could come and see what they’re worth?” Tang paused, then added, “There isn’t much cash, but I’ll gather whatever I can.” “How much?” “I can’t say at once. First we must value the objects and see what is lacking; then I’ll try to find a way.” This was a story Tang had invented to appeal to Zhou’s tastes. Zhou’s interest in jade was well known in the collectors’ tea gatherings. Taking Tang at his word, he readily agreed. “Very well. When shall I come?” “Would this evening suit you? My concubine cooks very well. I’ll ask her to show what she can do, and you can judge her skill.” The invitation stirred both Zhou’s lust and his appetite. Still, he could not ignore Yang and Ma. “You shouldn’t invite only me.” “I understand. It would be awkward for me to invite His Honour Ma, but I’ll ask Clerk Yang as well.”

zh: 杨书办是故意躲开的，根本没有什么事要料理，所以发觉唐子韶与周少棠的谈话已告一段落，随即赶了出来留客。“便饭已经快预备好了，吃了再走。”“谢谢！谢谢！”唐子韶连连拱手，“我还有事，改日再来打搅。顺便提一声：今天晚上我请周少棠到舍下便饭，请你老兄作陪。”说成“顺便提一声”，可知根本没有邀客的诚意，而且杨书办也知道他们晚上还有未完的话要谈，亦根本不想夹在中间。当即亦以晚上有事作推托，回绝了邀约。送走唐子韶，留下周少棠，把杯密谈，周少棠将前一天去看胡雪岩的情形，说了给杨书办听。不过，他没有提到胡雪岩劝他去骑月如那匹瘦马的话。这倒并非是他故障隐瞒，而是他根本还没有作任何决定，即使见了动心，跃跃欲试，也要看看情形再说。“胡大先生倒真是够气概！”杨书办说：“今日之下，他还顾念着老交情！照他这样厚道来看，将来只怕还有翻身的日子。”“ 难！他的靠山已经不中用，他本人呢，锐气也倒了，哪里还有翻身的日子？”周少棠略停一下说：“闲话少说，言归正传，你看要唐子韶吐多少出来？”“请你作主。”周少棠由于对月如存着企图，便留了个可以伸缩的余地，“多则一半，少则两三万。”他说，“我们三一三十一。”
en: Yang had deliberately withdrawn and had nothing to attend to. Realizing that their conversation had ended, he immediately came out to urge them to stay. “Lunch is almost ready. Have it before you go.” “Thank you, thank you!” Tang clasped his hands repeatedly. “I have something to do. I’ll trouble you another day. By the way, I’ve invited Zhou to a simple dinner at my house tonight. Please join us.” The phrase “by the way” showed how little sincerity there was in the invitation. Yang also knew they had unfinished business to discuss and had no wish to come between them. Claiming an engagement that evening, he declined. After seeing Tang off, he kept Zhou for a confidential conversation over wine. Zhou described his visit to Hu the day before, omitting the suggestion that he ride Yueru, the “slender horse.” This was not deliberate concealment; he had simply made no decision. Even if the sight of her tempted him, he would first have to judge the circumstances. “Mr Hu has real generosity of spirit,” Yang said. “Even now he remembers old affections. A man as kindhearted as that may yet rise again.” “Hardly. His powerful patron is no longer any use, and his own spirit is broken. How can he rise again?” Zhou paused. “Enough of that. To business: how much should we make Tang disgorge?” “You decide.” Having designs on Yueru, Zhou left himself room to maneuver. “Half at most; twenty or thirty thousand at least. We three will divide it equally.”

zh: 唐子韶家很容易找，只要到公济典后面一条巷子问一声“唐朝奉住哪里？”自会有人指点给他看。是唐子韶亲自应的门，一见面便说：“今天很冷，请楼上坐。”楼上升了火盆，板壁缝隙上新糊了白纸条，外面虽然风大，里头却是温暖如春，周少棠的狐皮袍子穿不住了，依主人的建议脱了下来，只穿一件直贡呢夹袄就很舒服了。“周先生，要不要‘香一筒，？”唐子韶指着烟盘说。“你自己来。”周少棠说：“我没有瘾，不过喜欢躺烟盘。”“那就来靠一靠。”唐子韶令丫头点了烟灯，然后去捧出一只大锦盒来，放在烟盘下方说道：“周先生，你先看几样玉器。”两人相对躺了下来，唐子韶抽大烟，周少棠便打开锦盒，鉴赏玉器，那锦盒是做了隔板的，每一层上面三块汉玉，每一块的尺寸大致相仿，一寸多长，六七分宽，上面刻的篆字，周少棠只认得最后四个字。“这是‘刚卯’。”周少棠指着最后四个字说：“一定有这四个字：”莫我敢当‘。““喔，”唐子韶故意问说：“刚卯作啥用场？”“辟邪的。”“刚卯的刚好懂，既然辟邪，当然要刚强。”唐子韶说：“卯就不懂了。”“卯是‘卯金刀’，汉朝是姓刘的天下。还有一个说法，要在正月里选一个，所以叫刚卯。”“周先生真正内行。”“玩儿汉玉，这些门道总要懂的。”说着周少棠又取第二方，就着烟灯细看。
en: Tang’s house was easy to find. One had only to go into the lane behind Gongji Pawnshop and ask where Pawnbroker Tang lived; someone would point it out. Tang answered the door himself. “It’s very cold today. Come upstairs.” A brazier was burning there, and fresh strips of white paper covered the cracks in the wooden partitions. Though the wind outside was strong, the room was as warm as spring. Zhou could not bear to keep his fox-fur robe on. At his host’s suggestion, he removed it and was perfectly comfortable in his lined jacket of woolen satin. “Would you care for a fragrant pipeful?” Tang asked, indicating the smoking tray. “You go ahead. I have no craving, though I like reclining beside a smoking tray.” “Then make yourself comfortable.” Tang told a maid to light the opium lamp, brought out a large brocade-covered box, and placed it below the tray. “Have a look at a few jades first.” They lay facing each other. Tang smoked while Zhou opened the box to examine its contents. It was divided by removable trays. On the top lay three Han jades, each roughly the same size: a little over one cun long and six or seven fen wide. Zhou could recognize only the last four seal-script characters carved on them. “These are gangmao amulets,” he said, pointing. “They must have these four characters: ‘None dare confront me.’” “Oh?” Tang asked deliberately. “What are gangmao used for?” “Warding off evil.” “Gang means strong—that I understand. Naturally, something that wards off evil must be strong. But I don’t understand mao.” “Mao, together with ‘gold’ and ‘knife,’ gives the surname Liu. The Han was the Liu dynasty. Another explanation says the choice must be made in the first month of the year; hence the name gangmao.” “You really are an expert.” “Anyone who collects Han jade must know such things.” Zhou took up the second piece and examined it by the opium lamp.

zh: “你看这三块刚卯，怎么样？”“都还不错。不过……”唐于韶见他缩口不语，便抬眼问道：“不过不值钱？”“也不好说不值钱。”周少棠没有再说下去。唐子韶当然明白，他的意思是，几万银子的亏欠，拿这些东西来作抵，还差得远，因而也就不必再问了，只伸手揭开隔板说道：“这样东西，恐怕周先生以前没有见过。”周少棠拿起来一看，确是初见，是很大的一块古色斑斓的汉玉，大约八寸见方，刻成一个圆环，再由圆环中心向外刻线，每条线的未端有个数目字，从一到九十，一共是九十条线，刻得极细极深极均匀。“这是啥？象个罗盘。”“不错，同罗盘差不多，是日规。”“日规？”周少棠反复细看，“玉倒确是汉玉，好象出土不久。”“法眼、法眼！”唐子韶竖起大拇指说：“出土不过三四年，是归化城出土的。”“喔，”周少棠对此物颇感兴趣，“这块玉啥价钱？”“刚刚出土，以前也没有过同样的东西，所以行情不明。”唐子韶又说：“原只要当一千银子，我还了他五百，最后当了七百银子。这样东西，要遇见识货的，可以卖好价钱。”“嗯。”周少棠不置可否，去揭第二块隔板，下面是大大小小七八方玉印。正取起一块把玩时，只听得楼梯上有响声，便即侧身静听。
en: “What do you think of these three gangmao?” “They’re all quite good. But…” When Zhou stopped, Tang looked up. “But they aren’t worth much?” “I wouldn’t say that.” Zhou went no further. Tang understood: against a debt of tens of thousands, objects like these would fall far short. There was no need to ask more. Lifting the partition, he said, “I doubt you have seen anything like this before.” Zhou picked it up. It was indeed new to him: a large piece of Han jade with a rich, mottled patina, about eight cun square, carved with a circular ring. Lines radiated outward from the center, each ending in a number, from one to ninety. There were ninety lines in all, exceptionally fine, deep, and evenly cut. “What is it? It looks like a compass.” “Yes, rather like one. It’s a sundial.” “A sundial?” Zhou examined it repeatedly. “The jade is certainly Han. It looks as though it was excavated recently.” “A discerning eye!” Tang held up his thumb. “Only three or four years ago, in Guihua City.” Intrigued, Zhou asked, “What is it worth?” “It’s only recently come to light, and nothing like it had been seen before, so there’s no established price. The owner originally wanted a loan of a thousand taels. I offered five hundred, and we finally settled on seven hundred. In the hands of someone who appreciates it, it could fetch a good price.” Zhou murmured without committing himself and lifted the second partition. Beneath it lay seven or eight jade seals of various sizes. He had just picked one up when footsteps sounded on the stairs. Turning onto his side, he listened.

zh: “你去问问老爷，饭开在哪里？”语声发自外面那间屋子，清脆而沉着，从语声的韵味中，想象得到月如过了风信年华，正将步入徐娘阶段的年龄。这样在咫尺之外，发号施令，指挥丫头，是不是意味着她不会露面？转念到此，周少棠心头，不免浮起一丝怅惘之感。此时丫头进来请示，唐子韶已经交代，饭就开在楼上，理由仍旧是楼上比较暖和。接着，门帘启处，周少棠眼前一亮，进来的少妇，约可三十上下年纪，长身玉立，鹅蛋形的脸上，长了一双极明亮的杏眼，眼风闪处，象有股什么力量，将周少棠从烟榻上弹了起来，望着盈盈含笑的月如，不由得也在脸上堆满了笑容。“这是小妾月如。”在烧烟的唐子韶，拿烟签子指点着说：“月如，这是周老爷，你见一见。”“喔，是姨大大！”周少棠先就抱拳作揖。“不敢当，不敢当！”月如裣作礼，“周老爷我好象哪里见过。”“你自然见过。”唐子韶说：“那天阜康门口搭了高台，几句话说得挤兑的人鸦雀无声，就是周老爷。”
en: “Ask the master where dinner is to be served.” The voice came from the outer room, clear and composed. Its tone suggested that Yueru was past the first bloom of womanhood and approaching the age of mature charm. Giving orders to a maid from only a few steps away—did that mean she would not appear herself? A slight disappointment rose in Zhou. When the maid came to inquire, Tang ordered dinner served upstairs, again because it was warmer. Then the curtain lifted, and Zhou’s eyes brightened. The woman who entered was about thirty, tall and graceful, with an oval face and exceptionally bright almond-shaped eyes. As her glance swept towards him, some force seemed to spring him from the smoking couch. Looking at her gentle smile, he found his own face wreathed in smiles. “This is my concubine, Yueru,” Tang said, indicating her with his opium needle as he prepared another pipe. “Yueru, this is Mr Zhou. Make your greeting.” “Ah, Madam!” Zhou clasped his hands and bowed first. “You are too kind!” She curtsied. “Mr Zhou, I feel I’ve seen you somewhere.” “Naturally you have,” Tang said. “Remember the platform outside Fukang, and the few words that silenced everyone demanding their money? That was Mr Zhou.”

zh: “啊！我想起来了。”月如那双眼睛，闪闪发亮，惊喜交集，“那天我同邻居去看热闹回来，谈周老爷谈了两三夭。周老爷的口才，真正没话说。这倒还在其次，大家都说周老爷的义气，真正少见。胡大先生是胡财神，平常捧财神的不晓得多少，到了财神落难，好比变了瘟神，哪个不是见了他就躲，只有周老爷看不过，出来说公道话。如今一看周老爷的相貌，就晓得是行善积德，得饶人处且饶人，有大福气的厚道君子。“这番话说得周少棠心上象熨过一样服帖，当然，他也有数，“得饶人处且饶人”，话中已经递过点子来了。“好说，好说！”周少棠说：“我亦久闻唐姨太太贤惠能干，是我们老唐的贤内助。唐子韶一听称呼都改过了，知道周少棠必中圈套，“随你奸似鬼，要吃老娘洗脚水”，心中暗暗得意，一丢烟枪，翻身而起，口中说道：“好吃酒了。”
en: “Ah, now I remember!” Her eyes sparkled with delighted surprise. “I went with our neighbors to watch. We talked about you for two or three days afterward. Your eloquence is beyond praise. But that is the lesser thing. Everyone says your loyalty is truly rare. Mr Hu was the God of Wealth; who knows how many people flattered him then? Once misfortune struck, he became a God of Pestilence, and everyone fled at the sight of him. Only you could not bear it and came forward to speak fairly. Now that I see you, I can tell you’re a blessed, kindhearted gentleman who does good, earns merit, and shows mercy wherever he can.” Her words soothed Zhou as though his heart had been gently ironed. Naturally, he recognized the hint conveyed by “shows mercy wherever he can.” “You are too kind. I too have long heard how capable and virtuous Mistress Tang is—a worthy helpmate to our Old Tang.” Hearing this change of address, Tang knew Zhou was certain to fall into the trap. “Cunning as a devil, yet you’ll drink the water a woman has washed her feet in,” he thought smugly. Tossing aside his pipe, he sprang up. “Time for wine!”
